updates.summary: Economic and energy stress remained severe while the coercive apparatus showed no evidence of systemic fracture.
Diplomacy suffered a setback while fiscal and energy stress worsened; managed oil transit through Hormuz improved for Gulf producers without restoring Iran's own export position.

Monetary / FX.text: Warning: depreciation, liquidity growth and a large managed/free-market spread show substantial movement toward an acute FX threshold.

Fiscal.text: Warning: weak sovereign financing demand, high yields and impaired oil revenue increase financing stress; ordinary financing has not clearly failed.

Banking / payments.text: Warning: alternative payment rails and import settlement face material sanctions friction, but nationwide payment-system failure is not established.

Food / medicine.text: Warning: medicine and imported-input shortages are material; evidence does not establish generalized essential-food failure.

Energy / industrial.text: Critical: rationing and conservation are now affecting work patterns and industrial/logistics activity; priority allocations are not yet known to be failing.

Social / protest.text: Watch: economic protests have broadened but remain fragmented rather than sustained nationwide coordinated unrest.

Coercive apparatus.text: Insufficient data on pay and benefits. Available reporting shows no verified refusal, desertion or defection, but absence of evidence is not coded green.

Elite cohesion.text: Watch: policy disagreement exists, but no open institutional fracture affecting command or governance is visible.

External support.text: Watch: China and Russia cushion isolation but do not replace lost oil FX and have incentives to limit destabilizing escalation.

news.title: Tehran's initial Hormuz proposal was rejected
news.impact: Reduced the negotiated-de-escalation scenario and raised prolonged-standoff and escalation cases.

news.title: Hormuz crude shuttles and managed flows increased despite severely depressed ordinary traffic
news.impact: Reuters/Kpler reporting documented continuing Saudi and Iraqi crude movement and ship-to-ship workarounds despite very low visible commercial traffic, lowering physical-delivery risk slightly without restoring Iranian oil revenue.

news.title: Emergency demand-management measures took effect
news.impact: Remote work, public-transport incentives and fuel-conservation measures strengthened evidence of a binding domestic energy imbalance.
news.source_note: Al Jazeera reported the government set 8am–1pm office attendance from September 23 with remaining hours remote, weekly public-transport days, and temporarily free metro/BRT as fuel-saving measures.

updates.what_changed: Diplomacy deteriorated while fiscal and energy evidence worsened; managed Hormuz crude movement improved without restoring Iran's own oil-export position.
updates.stabilizer: No verified coercive-system fracture or failure of priority military/security allocations.
updates.next_threshold: Whether economic and energy stress begins impairing priority state allocations or coercive-system compensation.

conditions.hormuz: Observation: commercial traffic remains severely restricted despite managed crude movements.
conditions.energy: Inference, high confidence: binding product and power constraints are producing active demand management.
conditions.coercion: No verified systemic compensation or discipline failure

forecasts.label: Sustained major regional escalation
forecasts.event_definition: Renewed sustained major interstate strikes or material geographic widening
forecasts.raise: Repeated major US–Iran strikes, broader Saudi–Houthi war, or failure of active mediation.
forecasts.lower: Verified ceasefire implementation, sustained Hormuz normalization, or direct negotiations producing enforceable constraints.

forecasts.label: Regime-ending transition
forecasts.event_definition: Loss or replacement of the Islamic Republic governing order
forecasts.raise: Verified elite fracture, security-force compensation failure, refusal to enforce orders, defections, or sustained coordinated nationwide unrest.
forecasts.lower: Oil/FX stabilization, declining protest coordination, durable elite cohesion, and continued reliable coercive-system compensation.

forecasts.label: FX crisis
forecasts.event_definition: Disorderly depreciation or payment shortage requiring broad emergency controls
forecasts.raise: Renewed rapid parallel-rate depreciation, failed intervention, further oil/payment-channel loss, import-payment breakdown, or accelerating monetary financing.
forecasts.lower: Sustained rial stabilization alongside restored oil receipts/payment access and narrowing official–parallel FX spread.

chains.name: FX / fiscal
chains.note: Depreciation and administrative intervention are clear; generalized high-frequency repricing and runaway monetization are not yet established.

chains.name: Energy / real economy
chains.note: Rationing/conservation, industrial/freight disruption and essential-goods stress are present; failure of priority allocations remains absent.

chains.name: Regime / coercion
chains.note: Economic protest is recurrent, but coordinated national protest, elite fracture and coercive refusal are not established.

haircut.note: Risk adjustment may appear through price, tenor, collateral or payment timing rather than an explicit discount.

absence_indicators.label: Security-force defections
absence_indicators.text: No verified consequential defections or unit-level refusal in current reporting.

absence_indicators.label: Nationwide bazaar shutdown
absence_indicators.text: No verified nationwide coordinated bazaar closure.

absence_indicators.label: Priority military/security fuel failure
absence_indicators.text: No failure is reported, but public observation is too weak to treat absence as affirmative reassurance.

absence_indicators.label: Economy-wide high-frequency wage indexation
absence_indicators.text: No evidence yet of generalized high-frequency automatic wage repricing characteristic of advanced inflationary breakdown.

absence_indicators.label: Systemically important Chinese-bank cutoff
absence_indicators.text: No verified cutoff by a major Chinese bank; Chinese support remains conditional but material.
